info.title: Cloudonym API
info.description: Multi-cloud resource naming engine for AWS, GCP and Azure. Generates, corrects and validates resource names against each provider's physical constraints. Cloudonym does not replace the provider's final verdict: it checks only the reserved words and patterns that the official documents state. Successful responses of /generate, /validate and /health carry version { engine, rules }; failures and /events do not. Every failure has the ErrorResponse shape; an unknown /v1 path or method returns 404 with code request.not_found. PASS / `valid: true` means the name satisfies the documented naming checks of this rules revision (length, pattern, reserved words). It does not mean the name is available or that you may create it — uniqueness, permissions, quotas and organisation policy are not checked. Generated names are not guaranteed unique: shortening can map two different contexts to the same name.

servers.description: Same host as this document (Cloudflare Worker)

post.description: Generates names and standard labels for every resource type of the requested providers from five context values. Names that cannot fit even after shortening are returned with valid=false and the reasons; nothing is silently truncated. Every violation, step and note is a Message: branch on code, show message to people.

400.description: Body is not JSON or not an object, context is invalid (including a value longer than 1024 characters), providers is not a non-empty array of supported providers, or rules_version is not a string

409.description: rules_version was sent and differs from the current rules revision (request.rules_version_mismatch; params.requested and params.current). The API never serves an old rules revision: re-run without rules_version to use the current rules, or keep using the names you already created

413.description: Request body is larger than 16 KB (request.body_too_large)

429.description: Too many requests from this client IP (60 per 60 seconds, shared by POST /v1/* and GET /llms.txt). Wait the number of seconds in Retry-After. errors[0].code is request.rate_limited

500.description: Unexpected server error (server.internal_error). The stack trace is logged, never returned

get.description: Always 200 while the Worker is up. Not rate limited.

env.description: Canonical: prd, stg, dev, sbx. Common aliases are accepted and normalised (production, prod, live -> prd; staging -> stg; development -> dev; sandbox -> sbx).

region.description: Canonical: kr, us, jp, eu, global. Provider region codes are accepted and normalised (asia-northeast3, ap-northeast-2, koreacentral -> kr; us-east-1, us-central1, eastus -> us; ap-northeast-1, asia-northeast1, japaneast -> jp; eu-west-1, europe-west1, westeurope -> eu).

providers.description: Omit for all three. Must be non-empty when present.

rules_version.description: Optional pin to a rules revision (YYYY-MM-DD.N). If it differs from the current revision the API answers 409 instead of returning names that may differ. Not a string -> 400.

data.description: provider -> resource_type -> ResourceItem. The provider set equals the requested providers.

generated_labels.description: provider -> standard tags/labels (owner, system, purpose, environment, managed_by)

label_violations.description: provider -> label values over the provider's limit or with characters the provider rejects (values are never truncated)

label_transformed.description: provider -> label values changed to fit the provider's character rules (GCP)

transformed.description: Context values normalised from aliases (context.normalized, e.g. env 'production' -> 'prd')

name.description: Final name. Empty when a required token became empty after normalisation.

valid.description: PASS / `valid: true` means the name satisfies the documented naming checks of this rules revision (length, pattern, reserved words). It does not mean the name is available or that you may create it — uniqueness, permissions, quotas and organisation policy are not checked. Generated names are not guaranteed unique: shortening can map two different contexts to the same name.

is_truncated.description: Optional tokens were dropped or tokens were shortened to fit

is_transformed.description: Characters were changed by normalisation or separators were removed

original.description: Name assembled before normalisation and shortening

violations.description: Why the name is invalid (empty when valid)

steps.description: Shortening and transformation steps in order (step.token_dropped, step.abbreviated, step.budget_shortened, step.normalized, step.separator_removed)

pattern.description: Provider's physical rule (regular expression source). Rebuild with new RegExp(pattern, pattern_flags).

pattern_flags.description: RegExp flags for pattern ('u' for Unicode classes, else empty)

allowed.description: Character set Cloudonym uses when generating (house style)

doc_url.description: Official document the numbers come from

notes.description: Notes on the rule, e.g. where a limit is deliberately conservative or reserved words apply (note.* codes). Always present, may be empty

Message.description: One reason, step, note or error. code is stable for machines; message is English text for people and may change between releases.

field.description: Context field (owner ...), token name, label key or request field (provider, providers[1], rules_version ...) the message is about

params.description: Values used in message. User values (from, to, value) are display strings: trimmed to 80 characters in request errors, non-strings shown as JSON; control, bidirectional and zero-width characters are shown as \uXXXX text in params and message

message.example: Name is 34 characters long; the maximum is 30

Version.description: engine = Cloudonym engine version; rules = rules revision (YYYY-MM-DD.N). A different rules revision may give a different name, verdict, suggestion or label for the same input.

resource_type.description: One of the provider's resource types; an unknown value returns 400 with the supported list

name.description: Longer than 1024 characters returns 400. Up to 1024, a name over the rule's max_length is judged by the engine (valid=false with a length violation).

rules_version.description: Optional pin to a rules revision (YYYY-MM-DD.N). If it differs from the current revision the API answers 409 instead of returning names that may differ. Not a string -> 400.

example.message: Name is 34 characters long; the maximum is 30

suggested_name.description: Present only when the name is invalid and a fix is possible

example.message: env 'qa' is not supported (prd, stg, dev, sbx)

supported.description: Accepted values, present when a provider, resource_type, event or providers entry is unknown, or when providers is not a non-empty array (request.providers_not_array, request.providers_empty)
